build_pretrained_model: build a pretrained transformer model from a Hugging Face model ID using from_pretrained with device_map and dtype arguments
save_pretrained_model: save a pretrained transformer model and its configuration to a local directory using save_pretrained
resize_token_embeddings: resize token embeddings of a pretrained model to a new vocabulary size with mean_resizing option
tie_model_weights: tie model weights such as embedding and language model head weights together using tie_weights
enable_gradient_checkpointing: enable gradient checkpointing on a pretrained model to reduce memory usage during training
